transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

My mom made me come. I just... I don't know. I can't really make myself do anything anymore. I just sit in my room... usually with the same clothes on. I don't knit or journal or go walking like I used to. And when she asks what's wrong, I just... I barely have the energy to answer her.
How long have you been feeling this way?
...I don't know. A long time, I guess. Since I started that community college program. That was... maybe two years and two months ago.
Have you ever had a period like this before?
...No. I don't think so. Just... since then.
During this time, have you felt depressed or down most of the day?
...No. Not really sad or anything. Just... empty, I guess. Nothing's there.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living or that you might want to hurt yourself?
...No. Never really thought about that. Just... I don't want to do anything like that.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports a chronic, long-standing loss of interest/pleasure and low energy with reduced self-care and reduced activity beginning about 2 years ago, without endorsing persistent sadness, suicidality, or discrete prior episodes. The presentation is most consistent with dysthymia/persistent depressive disorder (ICD-10 F34.1).
